info.name: Sanad App — Family reviews and medical access
info.description: Family booking reviews, dependent help acknowledgement and named medical-caregiver grants. Use disposable fixtures; no credentials are included.

item.name: Review completed booking
item.description: Family owner/editor only, after Completed. One immutable review per booking; success is 201.

item.name: Acknowledge dependent help request
item.description: FamilyAccess; dependent must belong to the caller’s family and the request must be pending.

item.name: Create named caregiver grant
item.description: Owner/editor only. Grantee must be an active Medical caregiver; multiple named recipients are supported. Duplicate active dependent/grantee grants are rejected. E03 audits successful grant creation and Families.AccessDenied authorization denials at this operation. Invalid/inactive grantee, duplicate grant, malformed request, and framework auth failures are not audited.

item.name: List grant recipients
item.description: Family members only. Active Medical caregivers with userId for grant creation; hasActiveGrant marks an existing active grant. No medical records are returned.

item.name: Revoke dependent grant
item.description: Revokes the grant and preserves revocation actor/time; success is 204. E03 audits successful revocation and Families.AccessDenied authorization denials at this operation. Unknown grant, malformed request, and framework auth failures are not audited.

item.name: List all dependent care records
item.description: FamilyAccess. Any family member reads all three sources — including CareHome-source records created from the care-home dashboard (read-only here). Optional source=Family|CareHome|Caregiver, visitDateFrom/To, search, page and pageSize filters. Search never examines medical details.

item.name: Create family-source care record
item.description: Owner/Editor only. Family/source/dependent/actor are derived by the API; success 201. The Idempotency-Key header is optional: leave familyCareRecordIdempotencyKey empty for the legacy behavior; the same trimmed key (1–128 printable ASCII, else 400 Families.CareRecords.IdempotencyKeyInvalid) with the same request replays the stored 201 body without a second record, and the same key with a different request is 409 Families.CareRecords.IdempotencyConflict. Replayed snapshots are retained for 7 days; cleanup is operational, not automatic. Mutation: use only an approved disposable fixture.

item.name: Update family-source care record
item.description: Owner/Editor only, family-source records only. A stale expectedVersion returns 409.

item.name: Delete family-source care record
item.description: Owner/Editor only, family-source records only; success 204. Mutation: only an approved disposable fixture.
